gui.eminus.settings.title: Eminus Settings
gui.eminus.settings.ingestion.hint: Convert the chunks you see into far-terrain cells. With it off, nothing new reaches the store.
The finest detail kept on disk: one voxel covers 2^level blocks. 0 keeps single blocks — a flower, a torch — at the far layer's nearest edge; 1 drops that level and cuts the store to about a seventh.
gui.eminus.settings.far_render_cells.hin: How far the far layer reaches. Work grows with the square of this distance: more meshes walked each frame, and more of them in video memory.
gui.eminus.settings.worker_threads.hint: Background threads that build far terrain. Higher catches up faster and competes harder with the game's own chunk builders; lower is the other way round.
gui.eminus.settings.subdivision_size.hin: How large a piece of far terrain may look on screen before finer pieces replace it. Measured in screen pixels, so a higher resolution goes finer at the same number. Smaller brings detail closer and costs more.
gui.eminus.settings.fog_mode.hint: What the far layer does where it ends. The game's own distance fog is pushed away while the far layer runs, so this is the only fog out there.
